description: The OpenCode v2 spelling of a provider block: providers (plural), the adapter under package, the address under settings, and the credential in an env list.

steps.description: This is a v2 configuration for an OpenAI-compatible endpoint such as an AI gateway. The page says it goes in your global config file, `~/.config/opencode/opencode.jsonc`.
In v2 the block is `providers` (plural). The provider has a `name`, an `env` list naming `MY_API_KEY`, and the adapter under `package`.
The address sits under `settings`, as `baseURL`, a placeholder for your URL.
`models` maps the gateway's model id to a display name.
The top-level `model` key sets the default to `custom/cloudflare_ai_gateway.anthropic/claude-sonnet-5`.

title: A v2 Provider Through an AI Gateway
